company.name: Rindler
company.shortDescription: Rindler develops a Model Context Protocol (MCP) platform enabling AI agents to interact reliably with websites that lack APIs.
company.description:
Rindler is an AI infrastructure company that develops an MCP (Model Context Protocol) platform enabling AI agents to interact reliably with websites that lack APIs. The company's platform maps websites into structured, deterministic tools, allowing AI agents to search, retrieve data, complete forms, execute transactions, and navigate authenticated websites without relying on web scraping or brittle browser automation.

Its platform provides website-to-API translation, MCP server infrastructure, authenticated session management, structured data extraction, workflow automation, bot detection handling, and deterministic web interactions. Rindler automatically maps websites into typed endpoints that AI agents can use to browse, search, fill forms, add items to carts, complete multi-step workflows, and access authenticated content through persistent sessions, eliminating the need for custom integrations or website-specific automation.

Rindler primarily serves AI developers, enterprise engineering teams, and organizations building autonomous AI agents. Its infrastructure enables developers to extend AI agents with reliable access to web applications and online services, allowing them to automate workflows across websites while maintaining consistent, structured interactions regardless of changes to website interfaces.
